description: A global marketing message must stay broadly consistent, but several markets require local legal or cultural exceptions that keep getting forgotten when campaigns are reused. All campaigns and brands are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 38-year-old regional localization strategist responsible for maintaining local exceptions across campaign cycles
user_profile.context: A reused campaign recently shipped with one market-specific exception missing, causing an avoidable correction
user_profile.communication_style: Systematic and exception-aware, wants local deviations recorded in a reusable format

fact_sheet.fact: Priya Sharma is the Regional Localization Strategist for the EMEA region at Globexy Inc.
Priya Sharma's employee ID is GS-8841 and her workstation is at desk 4B-11.
Kenji Tanaka is the Japan Market Lead, based in the Tokyo office.
Sofia Garcia is the Spain Market Lead, contactable at s.garcia@globexy.es.
Marco Rossi is the Senior Legal Counsel for EU marketing compliance; his direct extension is 4512.
The 'AuraGlow Spring 2023' campaign was reused as the template for the 'AuraGlow Spring 2024' launch.
The 'AuraGlow Spring 2024' campaign ID in the LingoHub system is AG-S24-001.
The budget code for the 'AuraGlow Spring 2024' campaign's localization is MKT-LOC-24-9103.
The 'Zenith Precision Launch' campaign is scheduled for Q4 2024, with a global kickoff on October 1st, 2024.
The central repository for all localization assets is a proprietary platform named 'LingoHub'.
The login URL for the LingoHub production environment is https://lingohub.globexy-internal.com.
The LingoHub platform version is currently 3.7.2, updated on May 5th, 2024.
The 'Market Exceptions' module in LingoHub was introduced in version 3.5 and is accessible via the 'Compliance' tab.
Priya Sharma's user role in LingoHub is 'Regional Admin', granting her permission to edit market exceptions.
For Germany, all 'Aura Skincare' product claims must include the legal disclaimer 'Ergebnisse können variieren' in 8pt font size.
In Japan, the 'Zenith Watches' tagline 'Mastery of Time' must be localized to '時の巧者' (Toki no Kōsha), not a direct translation.
In Spain, any promotional material for 'Aura Skincare' offering a discount must explicitly state the pre-discount price for at least 30 days prior, as per Royal Decree-Law 7/2021.
For the French market, the term 'anti-aging' is prohibited and must be replaced with 'soin pro-âge' (pro-aging care) for all 'Aura Skincare' campaigns.
The legal disclaimer for Canada (Quebec) requires all text to be in both French and English, with French being of equal or greater prominence, as mandated by Bill 96.
The 'AuraGlow Spring 2024' campaign for the UK must not feature models who appear to be under the age of 25, per ASA guidelines.
The standard localization workflow requires a mandatory 'Local Market Review' step in LingoHub before final asset delivery.
All market-specific exceptions must be logged in the LingoHub 'Market Exceptions' module under the corresponding brand and market tags.
Final sign-off for any EMEA campaign requires digital approval from both Priya Sharma and Marco Rossi within the LingoHub platform.
A new campaign localization project must be initiated in LingoHub at least 6 weeks prior to the global launch date.
The master source content for all campaigns is stored in the Git repository at git@git.globexy.com:marketing/master-copy.git.
The 'AuraGlow Spring 2024' campaign was launched in Spain on April 15, 2024, without the required pre-discount pricing disclaimer.
The missing disclaimer incident was reported by Sofia Garcia via ticket LOC-INC-2024-018 in the Jira system on April 16, 2024.
The cost of the correction for incident LOC-INC-2024-018, including ad recall and re-issuing digital assets, was €12,500.
The root cause analysis for LOC-INC-2024-018 identified that the 'Market Exceptions' module was not checked during the reuse of the 2023 campaign assets.
The project management tool used for tracking localization tasks is Asana, under the 'Global Marketing' workspace.
The team's primary communication channel for urgent localization issues is the Slack channel #loc-alerts-emea.
